- Q1 FY2027 (ended April 26, 2026): **$75.2B**, up 92% year‑over‑year. Source: S1.1.

Major growth drivers across these quarters include surging demand for AI‑training GPUs (H100/H200 platforms), expanding cloud‑provider spend, broader enterprise AI adoption, and the rollout of new architecture generations. All figures are from NVIDIA’s official earnings releases.
